props.gloss_en: from the mishna's 'within ITS year': we count the firstborn's year by its own year (not the calendar's)
Rav: the verse says 'before the Lord your God you shall eat it year by year (shana beshana)' (Devarim 15:20)
Rav's criterion: 'shana beshana' speaks of a year that enters into its fellow
Rav's bridge: say that this is the firstborn's year
the school of Rav: 'shana beshana' -- one day in this year and one day in that year
the firstborn is eaten for two days and one night
the school of Rav learn the own-year count from the other sacrifices
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: 'a lamb in its year' (Vayikra 12:6) -- its own year, not a year of the world's count
Rav: 'it shall be yours' -- Scripture added another 'being' for the firstborn
the school of Rav: this 'it shall be yours' teaches that a blemished firstborn is given to the priest, which we find nowhere else in the whole Torah
Rav: 'and their flesh' -- both unblemished and blemished
the school of Rav: 'and their flesh' speaks of the firstborns of all Israel
